projects.title: Mourgela et al. 2026 · Wildfire radiative effects and climate response
projects.description: Recompute radiative effects and climate diagnostics from archived EC-Earth3-AerChem output.
projects.report_summary: The archive analysis compares aerosol–cloud and aerosol–radiation effects, spatial significance, regional attribution, and fast and slow climate responses. The ozone contribution remains part of the radiative residual until a dedicated radiation calculation is available.

projects.title: Nawaz and Henze 2026 · Cross-border PM₂.₅ health benefits
projects.description: Review the inputs and methods for attributing PM₂.₅ health benefits across borders with GEOS-Chem Adjoint.
projects.report_summary: The study's source–receptor results and figure data are archived. The project notes identify the adjoint configuration and the sensitivity fields needed for a rerun. The archived figure data support comparison while those fields are being sourced.

projects.title: Clow et al. 2025 · Satellite sampling of SST and chlorophyll
projects.description: Reproduce the CESM2 satellite sampling comparison for sea surface temperature and chlorophyll, with E3SM ocean biogeochemistry comparisons.
projects.report_summary: EarthModelHub records the experiment configurations and separate historical case runs. The scientific target is the satellite-sampled OMIP2 comparison for 2003–2016. The historical runs and the sampling comparison have separate evidence requirements.

projects.title: Mahfouz et al. 2025 · Prescribed aerosol properties and forcing
projects.description: Compare prescribed aerosol optics and cloud condensation nuclei in SCREAM with interactive EAM aerosol simulations.
projects.report_summary: Paired 12 km SCREAM archive data support an annual forcing comparison. A one-day interactive EAM pair validates startup and diagnostics. The long-term interactive EAM forcing comparison remains open.

projects.title: Zelinka et al. 2023 · Aerosol forcing with APRP
projects.description: Recompute aerosol effective radiative forcing with approximate partial radiative perturbation and compare it with aerosol-free radiation calls.
projects.report_summary: The analysis compares archived APRP calculations and double radiation calls for CMIP5 and CMIP6 members. The detailed report tracks unavailable members, numerical agreement and radiative budget closure.

projects.title: Zhang et al. 2022 · Aerosol effective radiative forcing in E3SM
projects.description: Recreate the EAMv1 aerosol forcing diagnostics from archived data and apply them to EAMv3 wildfire experiments.
projects.report_summary: The archive analysis regenerates paper figures, supplement and tables. The EAMv3 wildfire experiments provide an application of the diagnostic workflow, with their own matched short integrations and comparisons.

projects.title: Leach et al. 2021 · FaIR v2 climate response
projects.description: Run the archived FaIR v2 workflow and compare historical and scenario responses with the paper.
projects.report_summary: The EMH report tracks figures redrawn from new FaIR outputs and the remaining ensemble constraints and figures. Open the EMH report for the comparisons and supporting data.

projects.title: Skeie et al. 2020 · Historical ozone radiative forcing
projects.description: Use ozone radiative kernels and archived model output to compare historical ozone forcing estimates.
projects.report_summary: The report compares completed historical windows and emissions snapshots with the author's archive. It records the alternative UKESM1-0-LL pressure-level input as a sensitivity calculation.

projects.title: Lawrence et al. 2019 · CLM5 land surface experiments
projects.description: Configure the CLM5 land experiment matrix and check cold starts at the target and coarser resolutions.
projects.report_summary: EMH records evidence from one-day cold starts. The published land diagnostics require the full experiment periods. Open the EMH report for the run evidence and Table 5 targets.
